## Loading Cleaned Data

We load the dataset that we cleaned in the previous file.

```{r}
# Load the cleaned dataset
load("13_DataSaving.RData")

# Create processed dataset
processed_data <- clean_data

# Save processed data
save(processed_data, file = "22_DataSaving.RData")
```

## Exploring the Data

We look at the variables and basic statistics to understand our dataset.

```{r}
# Check the structure
str(clean_data)

# Get summary statistics
summary(clean_data)

# Check the number of observations
nrow(clean_data)
```

## Processing the Data

We create a copy of the cleaned dataset to use for our analysis.

```{r}
# Load cleaned dataset
load("12_DataSaving.RData")

# Create processed dataset
processed_data <- clean_data

# Check the number of observations
nrow(processed_data)

# Check available data for 2020
sum(!is.na(processed_data$X2020))

# Save processed dataset
save(processed_data, file = "22_DataSaving.RData")
```

## Saving Processed Data

We save our processed dataset so we can use it to create graphs.

```{r}
# Save processed data
save(processed_data, file = "22_DataSaving.RData")
```
